{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_id_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicates = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1]

dup_count = len(duplicates)
print(f'Duplicate patient_id count: {dup_count}')
print(f'Patients with multiple rows: {list(duplicates.index)}')"}
